config.intent: Create a concise weekly AI newsletter for a developer audience. Focus on practical implications, new model releases, research breakthroughs, and developer tools. Skip hype, marketing fluff, and redundant announcements. Highlight anything that changes how developers should build AI-powered software.
sections: Top Stories (3-5 most important items, 2-3 sentences each)
Model & API Updates (new releases, pricing, capability changes)
Research Worth Reading (papers or blog posts with practical relevance)
